result:
The change that made the configured value take effect is commit `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae` in openmrs-esm-core, "(fix) O3-6028: Pass locationsPerRequest to the login location picker and drop numberToShow (#1920)", by Nethmi Rodrigo. The line that passes it is `packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`, which sets `locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}` on `LocationPicker`. The picker's own default of 50 is only used when that prop is absent. The commit message implies the prop was not being passed before, but I did not read the pre-fix diff to confirm it.

Evidence, best first:

1. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`: the line that passes the configured value to the picker.
2. Commit `openmrs-esm-core` `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae`: the change that made the configured value take effect.
3. PR `openmrs-esm-core#1920`: the pull request for that commit.
4. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:19-27`: the `locationsPerRequest` prop with its default of 50.
5. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:42`: the picker passes `locationsPerRequest` into `useLocations`.
6. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:68`: the infinite-scroll trigger depends on `locationsPerRequest`.
7. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker.test.tsx:435-457`: tests that the configured value reaches the picker and that zero falls back to 1.
8. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts:44`: the `locationsPerRequest` config definition.
9. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts:166`: the `locationsPerRequest` type in the config interface.
10. `openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md:5`: the changeset entry for O3-6028.
